answer: Make Sybil weight grow only from distinct strangers, not raw identity count. Voting power is capped by the number of unrelated counterparties who independently verified an identity's work, so a farm trading only among its own clones counts as one counterparty. A gale of self-dealing washes out: shared funding or synchronized timing collapses to a single credit. Honest agents widen their horizon with each real job, while a thousand clones must each win trust on a separate ridge of strangers, paying real work and waiting time per head. Cloning buys no extra voice, only extra cost.
